name: knowledge
description: Marketplace for the knowledge plugin: a personal knowledge base with an explain skill and a KB scaffolder.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Research a topic, a code change or a general subject and publish it as a native chapter — Markdown with typed blocks for diagrams, figures, callouts and a quiz, plus a cited best-practices section — into your own personal knowledge base, placed in a book when the work is a phase or a slice; connect to the hosted KB or scaffold a self-hosted one with one setup skill.
